review.notes: Cost: 1 wood. Printed points: 0. Effect 1: each time you build a stable, gain 1 food; if it's the last stable (no farmyard space remains for another / last in game), gain 3 food instead. 'Last stable' predicate not in vocabulary; threshold table on stable count used as provisional encoding. Effect 2: each time you build stables, you may build exactly 1 stable for 1 clay instead of wood. Per-build alternative payment not in established discount vocabulary; modeled as build_stable_alternate_cost. Verified via BGA Wiki (wiki_literature - complex card with last-stable detection and per-build alternate cost). Source: https://agricola.cloudfree.jp/?p=3033 (ja, 2026-11-16). 条件なし。コスト：1木。勝利点：0。効果：新たに厩1を建設するたび、食料1を得る。それが最後の厩なら代わりに食料3を得る。厩を建設するたび、ちょうど厩1を木材の代わりに粘土1で建設できる。プレイエリアに残る。
